claims.text: Suvorexant: 10 mg, no more than once per night; if well tolerated but not effective it can be increased, to a max of 20 mg.
claims.quote: The recommended dose for BELSOMRA is 10 mg, taken no more than once per night. If the 10 mg dose is well-tolerated but not effective, the dose can be increased. The maximum recommended dose of BELSOMRA is 20 mg taken no more than once per night.

claims.text: Suvorexant with moderate CYP3A inhibitors: the dose is 5 mg (generally no more than 10 mg); not recommended with strong CYP3A inhibitors.
claims.quote: When used with moderate CYP3A inhibitors, the recommended dosage of BELSOMRA is 5 mg taken no more than once per night (the dose generally should not exceed 10 mg). BELSOMRA is not recommended for use with strong CYP3A inhibitors
